newsitem.title: USA: Volt Information in $75 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Volt Information in $75 mln credit facility.

text.p: Volt Information Sciences Inc said Monday it has received a $75 million, three-year syndicated unsecured revolving credit facility.

The new facility will replace its current $10 million revolving facility with Chase Manhattan Bank, a Chase Manhattan Corp unit, and its $45 million accounts receivable securitization facility, Volt said.
Chase Securities Inc, also a Chase Manhattan Corp unit, acted as advisor and arranger for the new facility, which carries a borrowing cost lower than either of the two terminated financings, it said.
